title: Good first issues on GitHub · Help Wanted
excerpt: Discover 652,422 open source good first issues across 96,952 projects. Filter by language, difficulty, and category to find a first contribution.
content_html: Help Wanted is a live index of labeled good first issues and help-wanted issues from public GitHub repositories. Instead of paging through org boards, start here: every card is an open issue tied to an active project, with language, stars, and a difficulty score when we have one. Use the filters for a first pull request, or open a language hub for Python , TypeScript , JavaScript , Rust , Go , Java , HTML , or C++ . The feed above is the same list Google should see — crawlable project pages, not a query-string maze. New to contributing? Read how to find good first issues, then browse beginner-friendly projects.
